create_callback_subclass: create a subclass of Hydra Callback to add custom lifecycle hook logic
implement_on_run_start: implement the on_run_start method in a Callback subclass to run setup before job starts
implement_on_run_end: implement the on_run_end method in a Callback subclass to run cleanup after job ends
implement_on_job_start: implement the on_job_start method to log or track when each Hydra job begins
implement_on_job_end: implement the on_job_end method to process JobReturn data after each Hydra job completes
implement_on_compose_config: implement the on_compose_config method to inspect or modify the composed config before it is returned
